import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.path import Path from matplotlib.patches import PathPatch, FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 11, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "svg.fonttype": "path", })
ink = "#263238" blue = "#33658A" slate = "#657786"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(5, 3.5)) ax = fig.add_axes([0.035, 0.035, 0.93, 0.93]) ax.set_xlim(0, 10) ax.set_ylim(0, 7) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.axis("off")
# All coordinates are schematic drawing coordinates, not measurements. vertices = [ (3.00, 3.20), (2.65, 4.05), (3.10, 5.35), (4.15, 5.75), (5.10, 6.12), (5.60, 5.70), (6.45, 5.85), (7.55, 6.05), (8.80, 5.50), (9.10, 4.65), (9.50, 3.60), (8.65, 2.60), (7.45, 2.45), (6.35, 2.30), (5.90, 2.85), (5.00, 2.65), (4.10, 2.40), (3.35, 2.55), (3.00, 3.20), (3.00, 3.20), ] codes = [Path.MOVETO] + [Path.CURVE4] * 18 + [Path.CLOSEPOLY] boundary = PathPatch( Path(vertices, codes), facecolor="#F0F5F7", edgecolor=ink, linewidth=1.5, joinstyle="round", zorder=1, ) ax.add_patch(boundary)
origin = np.array([1.30, 1.30]) pi = np.array([4.15, 3.70]) pj = np.array([7.80, 4.40])
def arrow(start, end, color, linewidth=1.5, scale=12, **kwargs): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=scale, linewidth=linewidth, color=color, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, **kwargs ) ax.add_patch(patch) return patch
# A projected three-axis reference frame. arrow(origin, (2.55, 1.30), slate, linewidth=1.15, scale=9, zorder=2) arrow(origin, (1.30, 2.55), slate, linewidth=1.15, scale=9, zorder=2) arrow(origin, (0.48, 0.60), slate, linewidth=1.15, scale=9, zorder=2) ax.text(2.72, 1.30, r"$x$", ha="center", va="center") ax.text(1.30, 2.75, r"$y$", ha="center", va="center") ax.text(0.32, 0.43, r"$z$", ha="center", va="center") ax.plot(*origin, "o", color=ink, markersize=3.4, zorder=6) ax.text(1.07, 1.11, r"$O$", ha="right", va="top")
# Position vectors from the same origin. arrow(origin, pi, blue, linewidth=1.6, scale=12, zorder=3) arrow(origin, pj, blue, linewidth=1.6, scale=12, zorder=3) ax.text(2.55, 2.65, r"$\mathbf{r}_i$", color=blue, ha="right", va="bottom", fontsize=12) ax.text(4.95, 2.83, r"$\mathbf{r}_j$", color=blue, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12)
# Solid pairwise-distance segment, with inward endpoint clearance for the dots. distance_arrow = FancyArrowPatch( pi, pj, arrowstyle="<->", mutation_scale=12, shrinkA=4, shrinkB=4, linewidth=1.7, color=ink, zorder=5, ) ax.add_patch(distance_arrow) ax.plot([pi[0], pj[0]], [pi[1], pj[1]], linestyle="none", marker="o", markersize=5, markerfacecolor=ink, markeredgecolor="white", markeredgewidth=0.7, zorder=6)
ax.text(pi[0] - 0.16, pi[1] - 0.22, r"$P_i$", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=12) ax.text(pj[0] + 0.16, pj[1] - 0.20, r"$P_j$", ha="left", va="top", fontsize=12)
midpoint = (pi + pj) / 2 angle = np.degrees(np.arctan2(*(pj - pi)[::-1])) ax.text( midpoint[0] - 0.05, midpoint[1] + 0.36, r"$d_{ij}=\|\mathbf{r}_i-\mathbf{r}_j\|=\mathrm{const}$", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=11.5, rotation=angle, rotation_mode="anchor", zorder=7, )
ax.text(7.60, 3.00, "Rigid body", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, color=slate) ax.text(0.45, 6.55, "Rigid-body distance constraint", ha="left", va="center", fontsize=13, fontweight="medium") ax.text(9.55, 0.24, "Schematic • coordinates not to scale", ha="right", va="bottom", fontsize=8, color=slate)
